main.description: Accept a contribution to an entity you own, merging its changes permanently into your record. An owner may accept before any moderator has reviewed it.

contribution.description: URI of the contribution record to accept. Required unless contributionPatch is given.

contributionPatch.description: Deprecated: use contribution. URI of a moderator-approved contributionPatch, resolved to its contribution.

uri.description: URI of the updated entity record.
